name: saral
description: SARAL — Separation-of-Powers Cryptographic Key Management System

scripts.setup: npm --prefix backend run db:generate && npm run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -n BACKEND,FRONTEND -c "blue,green" "npm --prefix backend run dev" "npm --prefix frontend run dev"
scripts.build: npm run build:sdk && npm --prefix backend run build && npm --prefix frontend run build
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm run test:sdk
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix backend run typecheck && npm --prefix frontend run build && npm run typecheck:sdk
